$comment: LCARdS 2026.10.0-dev.1: index of the published JSON Schemas. Generated; do not hand-edit.
usage: Load the file for the card, view or strategy you are writing YAML for, plus the shared files it lists under "uses" (it references them as {"$ref": "../shared/<name>.json"}). Only use properties a schema declares; do not invent keys. lcards-schema.json at the site root holds everything in one file.

lcards-button.title: LCARdS Button Card Configuration
lcards-button.description: Complete configuration schema for lcards-button custom card

lcards-slider.title: LCARdS Slider Card Configuration
lcards-slider.description: Complete configuration schema for lcards-slider custom card

lcards-elbow.title: LCARdS Elbow Card Configuration
lcards-elbow.description: Complete configuration schema for lcards-elbow custom card with LCARS corner treatments. Supports dynamic theme integration via HA-LCARS input_number helpers (input_number.lcars_horizontal, input_number.lcars_vertical).

lcards-chart.title: LCARdS Chart Card Configuration
lcards-chart.description: Complete configuration schema for lcards-chart custom card (v1.18.0+ nested structure)

lcards-alert-overlay.title: LCARdS Alert Overlay
lcards-alert-overlay.description: Full-screen alert overlay card that reacts to the lcards_alert_mode input_select

lcards-select-menu.title: LCARdS Select Menu Card Configuration
lcards-select-menu.description: Renders an input_select entity as a grid of LCARS-styled option buttons. Each button calls input_select.select_option when tapped. The selected option is styled as "active", all others as "inactive".

lcards-msd-card.title: MSD Card
lcards-msd-card.description: Master Systems Display card with overlays and routing

lcards-layout-view.title: LCARdS Layout View
lcards-layout-view.description: Dashboard view type whose whole view is a CSS grid. Uses the lovelace-layout-card grid-layout schema: a `layout` block plus `cards` placed by `view_layout.grid-area`.

lcars-shell.title: LCARS Shell Dashboard Strategy
lcars-shell.description: Dashboard strategy that generates a full LCARS shell (header, sidebars, content panel) on a custom:lcards-layout-view. Set it as the dashboard's `strategy:` block. The room light list needs auto-entities (HACS).

rules.description: Dynamic styling rules evaluated by RulesEngine singleton. Rules can target overlays across all cards using IDs, tags, types, or patterns.

animation.description: Visual animation triggered by user interactions or entity state changes

filter.description: Filter configuration (CSS or SVG filter primitives)
